newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan Int'l Airline makes profit.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan Int'l Airline makes profit.

text.p: State-run Pakistan International Airline (PIA) said on Sunday it had earned a pre-tax profit of 208 million rupees in 1995/96 (July-June).
"The audited accounts of the airline for financial year 1995/96 have shown a profit before tax of 208 million rupees," a statement released after a PIA board meeting said.

It gave no comparative figures, but said PIA planned to increase its revenues 17.3 percent and spending 17 percent to enable it to earn a profit of 400 million rupees in 1996/97. PIA had introduced austerity measures to improve earnigs, it added.
